title: 2024-07-17 Special Meeting Builder GNIDA CAM Handover

pages.text:
Notice: Panchsheel Hynish AOA Special Meeting on 21st July 2024

Dear Residents,

On behalf of the Panchsheel Hynish Apartment Owners Association (AOA), we
are pleased to invite you to a special meeting scheduled to discuss the current
status of our ongoing discussions with the builder and the Greater Noida
Authority regarding the handover of CAM services of our society to AOA.

Details of the meeting are as follows:

Date: 21st July 2024
Time: 7:30 PM
Duration: 90 mins
Venue: Hynish Badminton Court

The agenda for this meeting includes:
1. Update on the progress so far
2. Issue raised with Builder for society
3. ⁠MOU discussion
4. Next steps and proposed action plan
5. Resolution on further plan for Handover
6. Open House

We look forward to your presence and active participation as i s crucial for a
transparent and collaborative handover process.

Warm regards,

On behalf of Board of management
